_about: One place for facts several components repeat. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/lumebook.py ripple. The dashboard (sites/dashboard/refresh.py) reads this file; tools/lumebook.py check flags copies elsewhere that disagree.

brand._instagram_live_source: Israeli product Reels research, 15 Oct 2026: @lumebook.il is the live handle and @lumebookai no longer loads for logged-out visitors. refresh.py still counts followers of 'instagram'.

offer._source: Yossi via Yarin, 2026-10-04; corrected 2026-10-07 (no discount code, personal link); 2026-10-08 the number is 25%; 2026-10-11 Yarin confirmed the split mechanics below
offer.allocation_rule: One 25% allocation per sale through the creator's personal link. The creator decides how much of it is their earnings and how much is an audience discount. The discount is applied automatically through the link. It is never 25% earnings plus an extra discount.
offer.commission_wording_he: 25% מכל מכירה דרך הקישור האישי, לחלוקה בין הרווח של היוצר להנחה לקהל (למשל 15% ליוצר ו-10% הנחה)

collaboration_tracks.gift: General: a personalised book in exchange for one agreed video, plus the personal-link arrangement. Commission only, no fee
collaboration_tracks.pro: Professionals: the same offer, written for therapists, parent guides, teachers and other professionals
collaboration_tracks.par: Parents: the same offer, written parent to parent

open_questions: How the sale value behind the 25% is calculated (price only, or shipping too)
How the personal link and its automatic discount are tracked and attributed at checkout
Whether the creator can change their split later

local_tools._about: Services that run on Yarin's Mac. The dashboard board checks them (from the project server, or from the page when the browser allows it) and shows how to bring them back; nothing in the browser starts them. refresh.py records whether each answered at refresh time.

tools.label: Carousel Machine
tools.runs_as: login item (launchd com.yarinbruner.hook-studio); never start a second copy
tools.runs_as_he: רץ כל הזמן על המק כפריט התחברות (launchd). לא מפעילים עותק שני: אחרי שינוי בסקריפטים שלו מריצים restart.

tools.label: שרת הפרויקט המקומי
tools.runs_as: the 'lumebook' preview config or a terminal
tools.runs_as_he: מופעל לפי הצורך, מהגדרת התצוגה lumebook או ממסוף בתיקיית הפרויקט.

drive_content._about: Yarin's My Drive folder for every finished piece of content (18 Oct 2026). Carousels are copied there by carousel/carousel-pipeline/scripts/drive_export.py through Google Drive for desktop.
drive_content.name: LumeBook תוכן

postiz._about: Postiz (api.postiz.com) channels, connected 26 Oct 2026 through the postiz CLI (~/.local/bin/postiz, sign-in in ~/.postiz/credentials.json). Carousel Machine sends finished carousels there (carousel/carousel-pipeline/scripts/postiz_export.py), scheduled for the date and time Yarin picks or as a draft: Instagram gets all 10 slides, Facebook gets slide 1 with the other slides written out as the post text. default_hour is the time the picker starts on (the carousel's own day).

admission._source: Yarin, 24 Oct 2026: from now on a new creator joins the creator map only if it passes all of these; creators already in the map are never removed or changed by them
admission.how: median views over the newest reels; likes and comments per 1,000 views are the median per reel over the 12 newest reels (3 reels with numbers at least), the same math as the card

parent_shoot_offer._source: Yarin, 2026-10-14. Separate from the creator offer (offer): families, not creators.
parent_shoot_offer.name_en: Home shooting day for social media, for a free book
parent_shoot_offer.wording_he: יום צילום לרשתות החברתיות של לומבוק, אצלכם בבית, תמורת ספר מותאם אישית במתנה
parent_shoot_offer.who_on_camera: the child (face visible) and a parent, with the book
parent_shoot_offer.posts_on: LumeBook's socials; the parent does not need to post or have followers
parent_shoot_offer.compensation: one free personalised book, the full compensation
parent_shoot_offer.eligibility: parent or legal guardian of every child on camera; children aged 1 to 10
parent_shoot_offer.base: Ashkelon, by public transport, closest families first
open_questions: Form built 15 Oct 2026 (script research/parent-community/lumebook-parent-form.gs); check the empty garbled test form left in Drive from the first run and delete it
Visit length and how many families per trip
Whether the shoot and book can be in Russian or English
